task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 headphones are in stock for 2 units, then prepare the recommended invoice request for me. After that, sort the 2-unit Sony XM5 item list in descending order, generate the invoice with the best discount and payment link, and then complete checkout for 2 black Sony XM5 headphones for user_001.

user_input.query: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 headphones in the electronics category are in stock for quantity 2, specifically product_id p_sony_xm5_blk. If they’re available, please prepare the recommended invoice request for me using email user@example.com. Then sort the 2-unit Sony XM5 item list in descending order, generate the invoice with the best discount and a payment link through stripe, and complete checkout for 2 black Sony XM5 headphones for user_id user_001.
